t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Find which gnomes give the most mushrooms and prioritise them. The values can change, so be prepared to switch gnomes if the amount of mushrooms received suddenly decreases.

vb_textbox.text: Figure out which gnomes give the most points on average. These values change over time, so prepare to alter your choices when the points values drop on your previous high value gnomes. If possible, use the 1x multipliers to scout unknown gnomes and use the 5x multipliers on safe bets. There seems to be no pattern for points value other than colour. Treat anything giving 3 points or below as an undesirable pick. Focus on a high average with consistency.
